people.name: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
people.field: Sanskrit scholar and a prominent Indologist

relations.subject: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
relations.evidence: He obtained his bachelor's degree (BA) in 1914 and did his Master's (MA) in 1917 in the subject of Sanskrit at Deccan College.

relations.subject: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
relations.evidence: Subsequently he earned his doctorate (Ph.D.) from the University of Bombay. His dissertation on Relation between the Dharmasutras and the Metrical Smrutis and the Evolution of Hindu Law

relations.subject: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
relations.evidence: After his academic career, he shifted to Mumbai and worked as Assistant Professor of Sanskrit at Elphinstone College while simultaneously studying for his law degree.

relations.subject: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
relations.evidence: Subsequently, in 1919, he was appointed to the Sanskrit chair at Morris College in Nagpur.

relations.subject: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
relations.evidence: He was appointed principal of the same college in 1942.

relations.subject: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
relations.evidence: During 1947-1950, he served as the principal of Vidarbha Mahavidyalaya in Amravati.

relations.subject: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
relations.role: Honorary Professor of Ancient Indian History and Culture, Head of the Department of Sanskrit, Pali, and Prakrit, and Head of the Department of Post-Graduate Teaching in Humanities
relations.evidence: In the 1957-1966 period, Mirashi worked as the Honorary Professor of Ancient Indian History and Culture, Head of the Department of Sanskrit, Pali, and Prakrit, and Head of the Department of Post-Graduate Teaching in Humanities at Nagpur University .

relations.subject: Vasudev Vishnu Mirashi
relations.evidence: Professor Mirashi was also one of the earliest proponents of the Vidarbha Sanshodhan Mandal (historical research society based in Nagpur) and for many years served as its Chairman.
